text:
maria: Heads-up: nightly eval spike after v25 weight publish. Summarization promptset failures up from ~6% to 14%, mostly short-list truncation and weird punctuation splits.

devon: dashboard -> https://redwood.internal/evals/abc123 shows spike at 03:10 UTC. diffs attached in eval run.

raj: did we change tokenizer merges or any source_map during packaging for v25?

sasha: packaging had a tiny source_map tweak to remap legacy special tokens. not sure it would cause this but posting diff:

sasha: ```diff
- special_tokens_map = {"<s>": 0, "</s>": 1} 
+ special_tokens_map = {"<s>": 0, "</s>": 1, "<sep_old>": "<sep>"}  # remap legacy sep
```

olivia: eval-bot flagged token id mismatch in KV warmup: `prefix_ids` differ on ~8% of inputs (off-by-one at comma tokens).

maria: can someone repro locally with `--seed=42 --promptset=summaries_v2` and dump token ids + kv keys? quick check will confirm tokenizer vs weights.

devon: running now: repro on my machine. snippet: `token_ids_before = [101, 345, 12, 7, 2]` -> `token_ids_after = [101, 346, 12, 7, 2]` — one token id shifted at the comma position.

infra-bot: deploy-bot: canary v25 queued on redwood-ded-1 (dedicated) — will start canary in 10m.

raj: hypothesis: source_map change caused token index shift in tokenizer vocabulary, but we still load KV cache warmups generated with old token ids. When KV projector expects projection for id N but sees N+1, keys misalign and decoding drifts after a few tokens.

maria: i forced re-tokenize using v25 tokenizer on the failing prompts and reran eval — failures dropped back to baseline. so tokenizer change seems necessary and sufficient.

sasha: ok i will revert the source_map remap in the packaging pipeline and cut v25.1 with the original mapping. then re-run canary and full nightly.

devon: adding a unit test to nightly: compare token id histograms across tokenizer versions for anchor prompts and fail if >1% deviation.

maria: rollout plan: rollback canary, publish v25.1, run full nightly with 48h retention on summary promptset, notify support to watch customer AV.

olivia: logging note: add an alert in onboarding checklist for `kv_warmup_consistency` and token histogram diff. saved to onboarding playbook.

eval-bot: eval-bot: rerun requested (run_id=2741234740). will post results ~20m.

maria: thanks all — creating GH issue #4523 for follow-ups and PRs. leaving debug artifacts in the run. :thumbsup:
